title: Decent Espresso Shot Extraction Yield Leaderboard
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=decent:shot extraction_yield_pct=*
| stats sum(extraction_yield_pct) as total_value, avg(extraction_yield_pct) as avg_value by espresso_profile
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks espresso profile values by total and average extraction yield across Decent Espresso shot events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `extraction_yield_pct` values for each Decent Espresso shot event and review total and average extraction yield by espresso profile.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total extraction yield.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which espresso profile shows the biggest extraction yield numbers in your Decent Espresso shot data.
